cases.caption: A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility.
cases.action: bending something so that it deforms
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The wood must be sufficiently pliable to bend without breaking.
The two individuals must apply opposing forces to bend the wood into a bow shape.
The wood must remain visibly bent in the bow shape throughout the process.
The bending action must be continuous to demonstrate flexibility.

cases.caption: A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates.
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The plastic ruler must be held horizontally and subjected to bending force until it visibly cracks.
The crack must propagate visibly along the ruler's length as the bending continues.
The ruler's material must exhibit a clear stress fracture pattern during the bending process.
The bending action must be performed in a controlled manner to ensure the fracture is clearly observable.

cases.caption: A construction worker uses a suction cup to lift a heavy glass panel with a small picture adhered to it; the picture remains affixed.
cases.action: lifting a surface with something on it but not enough for it to slide down
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A construction worker uses a suction cup to lift a heavy glass panel with a small picture adhered to it; the picture remains affixed. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The glass panel must be securely attached to the frame with the picture adhered to its surface.
The suction cup must be properly positioned and activated to create a secure seal on the glass surface.
The worker must apply controlled force to lift the panel without dislodging the picture.
The panel must be lifted vertically and held steady to prevent any movement or detachment of the picture during the process.

cases.caption: A rower pulls an oar from the water, the blade dripping water back into the lake. .
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A rower pulls an oar from the water, the blade dripping water back into the lake. . Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The oar blade must be fully submerged in the water before being pulled upward.
Water must visibly drip from the oar blade as it is lifted out of the water.
The rower must maintain a consistent posture and grip on the oar handle during the pull.
The kayak must remain stable and level on the water surface throughout the motion.
